name: Buffer
whatYouLose: Maintained API integrations across changing social platforms
Cross-network analytics and team approval workflows
Compliance with every platform's publishing edge cases
prompt: Build a single-account social post queue for one supported network. Users draft posts, attach images, preview formatting, choose a publish time, and see a calendar and queue. Store drafts and job state in SQLite, encrypt the platform token, publish from a background worker, retry transient errors, and show a clear failure inbox. Include timezone-safe scheduling, a password-protected admin, first-party engagement snapshots, tests with a mocked network API, and an Astro SSR interface using vanilla JavaScript.
notes: Yes for one or two networks you control. Reassess if your livelihood depends on every network integration always working.
